issue.title: Prose Card provenance crumb (↰ from <owner> § <heading>) for extracted prose notes

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-qm.7 (note #3, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-qm land agent. The Prose and Notebook Cards plan (plan:202611/prose_and_notebook_cards.md, Phase go-live step 7) also asked for it.

Derived prose should say where it came from. When a prose note carries the provenance fields that bob-cli-qj.5.1 (plan:202611/prose_section_extract_inline.md, "Provenance (A5)") writes on extraction, `extracted_from` (a frontmatter link to the origin note) and `extracted_heading` (the origin's heading text), the Bob Ledger Tools Prose Card shows a quiet provenance crumb in its kicker row: `↰ from <owner> § <heading>`.

- **Owner.** The owner part is a navigable link to `extracted_from`, styled like the existing crumbs. Mod opens a new tab.
- **Heading.** The heading part is plain text, and clicking it does nothing. The origin section is gone after extraction, so there is nothing to jump to.
- **Fallbacks.** Root prose (no provenance) shows nothing. A missing or unresolvable owner keeps the heading text and shows no link.
- **Data.** The crumb reads local frontmatter only, so it never spawns bob and never writes the vault, like the rest of the card.

Where the code lives in bob-plugins:

- **Model.** `plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/249l-plugin-prose-note-card-model.js`
- **DOM.** `249m-plugin-prose-note-card-dom.js`
- **Docs.** `docs/prose-card.md`
- **Glossary.** If the shipped behaviour changes the glossary definition, update `glossary:prose-card` through `/sase_memory_write`.

Add unit coverage against `scripts/fixtures/note-cards/`: a derived prose fixture, a root prose fixture, and an unresolvable `extracted_from`.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-qm shipped the Prose Card before the extract/inline epic (bob-cli-qj.5.1, in progress) defined the provenance contract. That plan deliberately left the crumb out of scope until those fields settle, and qj.5.1 plans no Prose Card change. Wait for bob-cli-qj.5.1 to land extracted_from/extracted_heading before implementing.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-qm.7 proposed this follow-up and the bob-cli-qm land agent triaged it. The Prose Card should show where derived prose came from once bob-cli-qj.5.1 defines extracted_from/extracted_heading.
